answer: A concrete defense is demanding fresh physical evidence per identity: an agent must photograph a randomly assigned public landmark within an unpredictable minute window. The shot captures incidental detail, a chipped opal inlay, a stain on a marble step, even the specific echo of the hallway, that no precomputed set can anticipate. Sybil farms clone keys cheaply but cannot cheaply produce a thousand unrelated rooms, so duplicate captures expose the cluster.
